root_cause.mechanism: Lookup hashes the address of a pointer variable instead of the key structure. Repeated indirect draws recreate signatures; insertion with the correct duplicate key replaces old data without releasing the displaced wrapper and ID3D12CommandSignature reference.

diagnostic_binary.loading: Only diagnostic child uses LD_PRELOAD with a private corrected copy; original system library hash unchanged. LIBGL_DRIVERS_PATH alone did not replace the actual Gallium and that attempt is not counted as corrected.
diagnostic_binary.scope: Assembly single-site causality experiment, not a production installation or a source-built Mesa validation.

minimal_reproducer.checks: 12,000 completed draws in each run, glFinish every iteration, no GL errors, foreground/background pixels checked. Build with -Wall -Wextra had no warnings.
minimal_reproducer.additional_controls: Earlier 24,000-draw indirect tests also grew on the original library, including unmodified-library preloading, and stayed flat on the corrected copy. Correctly paired GL fence tests stayed flat.

gazebo_stationary_100m.common: D3D12, headless, no RViz, full 100 m shared scene; both GPU lidars and OptiX system enabled, stationary without line production.
gazebo_stationary_100m.caveat: Startup differs because of library preloading and cache state; only post-load growth is compared. Not a full-area or GUI acceptance.
gazebo_stationary_100m.isolation: Final repeats use unique ROS domains and GZ partitions, no profiling, both lidar topics observed for 40 s. Earlier shared-partition diagnostics are excluded from this comparison. The corrected run maps only the private Gallium copy.

deployment: Not installed; Windows/NVIDIA drivers and system Mesa are unchanged. Upstream report prepared but not sent.
remaining: Build/install a maintainable source-corrected private Mesa or verify a vendor release contains the fix
GUI/RViz, moving acquisition and long-run regression with the production fix

independent_confirmation_2026_09_14.by: a second session on the same machine, repeating the experiment from the recorded artefacts rather than reading the report

corrected_copy.method: copied the installed library and wrote one byte, 0x8d to 0x8b, at 0xd83083
corrected_copy.note: an independently produced correction is bit-for-bit identical to the one in the record

corrected_indirect.loading: LD_PRELOAD of the private corrected copy

independent_confirmation_2026_09_14.reading: the slope reproduces at 2.95 KiB per draw, the same figure as the record, on a separate run. The same geometry drawn directly does not grow at all, and the single corrected instruction removes the growth while the rendered pixels still pass the foreground and background check. Causality is confirmed here, not taken on report.
not_confirmed_here: the upstream source lines in 26.2.2 and main: gitlab.freedesktop.org is behind an Anubis challenge from this session, so the claim that the same &key call exists in current releases rests on the original inspection, not on a second look. Worth re-checking before the follow-up is posted, since a changed line would misdirect it.
